backgrounds.description: The Gardens by the Bay at twilight, with orchids and exotic ferns
backgrounds.prompt: A wide open space overlooking Gardens by the Bay at twilight. Soft bioluminescent light and cool ambient glow illuminate lush interior orchids and exotic ferns. In the distance, majestic illuminated Supertrees rise into a deep violet evening sky, glowing with vibrant magenta and warm gold lights.
backgrounds.title: The Gardens by the Bay at twilight

backgrounds.description: A cinematic, mid-distance view of marina bay hotel in the night
backgrounds.prompt: A cinematic, mid-distance view across the dark water at night, bringing the glowing lotus structure of the ArtScience Museum into the immediate foreground. Towering directly behind it, the monumental Marina Bay Sands hotel looms grandly into the night sky, creating a dramatic sense of scale where the landmarks feel intimately detailed yet grandly immense, with vibrant night lights reflecting across the bay.
backgrounds.title: The Marina Bay Scene

backgrounds.description: A cinematic, mid-distance view at night focusing on the iconic Merlion statue
backgrounds.prompt: A cinematic, mid-distance view at night focusing on the iconic Merlion statue, brilliantly illuminated as a stream of water spouts into the dark bay. In the background, the glowing Marina Bay city skyline creates a grand, luminous backdrop, with vibrant night lights and architecture reflecting shimmering colors across the water's surface.
backgrounds.title: The Merlion Park

backgrounds.description: Elegant colonial-era porch featuring emerald Peranakan tiles, louvered shutters, and a traditional Malay feast
backgrounds.prompt: an elegant colonial-era veranda in Singapore, with gleaming emerald-green Peranakan floor tiles and white louvered shutters. Soft morning sunlight filters through a lush tropical garden of oversized monstera leaves and blooming hibiscus. In the distance, a beautifully set dining table holds antique brass trays filled with traditional Malay delicacies,
backgrounds.title: Singapore Heritage Veranda

backgrounds.description: Epic panoramic view of snow-covered mountains with sunburst and ice formations
backgrounds.prompt: An epic, ultra-realistic panoramic view of a snow-covered mountain range at dawn. Massive, jagged ice formations in the foreground reflect pale-blue and violet light. A rare sunburst pierces through the heavy cloud cover, casting golden light beams across the frosted landscape.
backgrounds.title: The Frozen Sunburst Summit

backgrounds.description: A minimalist winter courtyard at twilight with a frozen, jet-black obsidian pond
backgrounds.prompt: A minimalist winter western-style courtyard at twilight with a frozen, jet-black obsidian pond. The surrounding trees are crafted from hand-blown frosted glass and crystalline silver, catching the moonlight. The ground is a dark, wet slate that reflects the deep indigo sky.
backgrounds.title: The Winter Courtyard

backgrounds.description: Storm clouds part as sun-moon halo crowns the ancient jade mountains.
backgrounds.prompt: A remote mountain ridge at night, rendered in ultra-photorealistic detail. Jagged dark-jade cliffs and ancient stone formations fade into mist. In the distant sky, a rare sun-moon halo glows behind layered storm clouds, casting silver-gold light across the landscape.
backgrounds.title: Halo Over the Jade Ridge

backgrounds.description: Dreamy cherry blossom forest with glowing petals and floating spirit-lights
backgrounds.prompt: A moonlit forest of cherry blossom trees with luminous, pale-pink petals that glow from within. The ground is a soft carpet of fallen blossoms, and small, floating spirit-lights (will-o'-the-wisps) drift between the branches. A soft-focus, dreamy background with a deep indigo sky and a giant, silver full moon.
backgrounds.title: The Ethereal Moonlit Blossom Forest

Surrounding the waterfall, the lush, multi-tiered indoor forest of the Shiseido Forest Valley creates a grand, tropical backdrop, with soft mist and hidden accent lights reflecting shimmering colors across the dense canopy.
